entity.name: concept
entity.query: select c.concept_id, c.concept_code, c.concept_name, c.concept_name as orig_concept_name, c.concept_class_id, c.domain_id, c.vocabulary_id, c.valid_start_date, c.valid_end_date, c.concept_name_length, c.concept_word_count, 'Concept' as term_type, case valid_end_date when '2099-12-31' then 'Active' else 'Inactive' end as concept_status from ${dataimporter.request.vocab_database_schema}.concept as c UNION select cs.concept_id, c.concept_code, cs.concept_synonym_name as concept_name, c.concept_name as orig_concept_name, c.concept_class_id as concept_class_id, c.domain_id as domain_id, c.vocabulary_id as vocabulary_id, c.valid_start_date as valid_start_date, c.valid_end_date as valid_end_date, cs.concept_synonym_name_length as concept_name_length, cs.synonym_word_count as concept_word_count, 'Synonym' as term_type, case valid_end_date when '2099-12-31' then 'Active' else 'Inactive' end as concept_status from ${dataimporter.request.vocab_database_schema}.concept_synonym as cs join ${dataimporter.request.vocab_database_schema}.concept as c on cs.concept_id = c.concept_id
